answer_1.quote: The key idea of the SCAIN extraction architecture is to simulate the interpretation of a statement from two different perspectives: a listener who has missed some previous statements and a speaker who has not missed any statements.
answer_1.outputs: Rephrased statements that represent the interpretation of a core statement in different dialogue contexts (complete vs. omitted)

answer_2.quote: We compute the similarity score between two embedding vectors. The similarity score between the embeddings is computed as the cosine similarity.

answer_4.quote: We crowdsourced 30 raters. We created 10 online questionnaires and assigned three raters to each questionnaire.
answer_4.guideline: The raters assessed the interpretation of the core statement in the dialogues by using the following metrics: clarity and suddenness were assessed for each dialogue and difference was assessed for the comparison between the complete and omitted dialogues.
